tools.name: goaffpro_list_affiliates
tools.description: List the affiliates of the program with status, ref code, coupon, group and contact fields. GET /admin/affiliates. Answer: { affiliates: [] }.

tools.name: goaffpro_search_affiliates
tools.description: Search affiliates by a keyword in name, ref_code, email or coupon. GET /admin/affiliates/search. Answer: a list of affiliates.

tools.name: goaffpro_list_orders
tools.description: List orders that are tied to affiliates, with total, commission, status (approved or rejected) and the date. GET /admin/orders. Answer: { orders: [] }.

tools.name: goaffpro_list_rewards
tools.description: List rewards (bonuses) given to affiliates. GET /admin/rewards. Answer: { rewards: [] }.

tools.name: goaffpro_list_payments
tools.description: List the payment history to affiliates (amount, method, date). GET /admin/payments. Answer: { payments: [] }.

tools.name: goaffpro_list_payment_requests
tools.description: List payment requests that affiliates made from their dashboard. GET /admin/payments/requests. Answer: { PaymentRequests: [] }.

tools.name: goaffpro_get_pending_payouts
tools.description: Show the amount due to each affiliate up to a date. GET /admin/payments/pending. Answer: { pending: [{ affiliate_id, amount }], upto }.

tools.name: goaffpro_list_transactions
tools.description: List the transaction log (commission credits, payouts, balances) per affiliate. GET /admin/transactions. Answer: { transactions, count, limit, offset }.

tools.name: goaffpro_list_traffic
tools.description: List visits that affiliate links sent to the store (landing page, referrer, time). GET /admin/traffic. Answer: { traffic: [] }. Max limit 1000.

tools.name: goaffpro_list_coupons
tools.description: List the coupon codes that are assigned to affiliates. GET /admin/coupons. Answer: { coupons: [] }.

tools.name: goaffpro_list_groups
tools.description: List affiliate groups and their commission settings. GET /admin/groups. Answer: { groups: [] }.

tools.name: goaffpro_list_special_commissions
tools.description: List the special commission rates set for products and collections. GET /admin/commissions. Answer: { commissions: [] }.

tools.name: goaffpro_list_connections
tools.description: List the links between affiliates and customers. GET /admin/connections.

tools.name: goaffpro_set_affiliate_status
tools.description: WRITE: approve, reject or set to pending one affiliate. The affiliate may get an email from GoAffPro. PATCH /admin/affiliates/{id}.

tools.name: goaffpro_add_affiliate_coupon
tools.description: WRITE: add a discount coupon code to one affiliate. This changes the store discounts. A repeat call can create a second coupon. POST /admin/affiliates/{id}/coupons.

findings.title: Read-only tool requests dangerous parameters
findings.detail: Tool "goaffpro_list_coupons" appears informational but accepts parameters (code) that enable code/file/secret access.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: goaffpro_search_affiliates, goaffpro_set_affiliate_status · Private data: goaffpro_list_affiliates · Public sink: goaffpro_search_affiliates, goaffpro_set_affiliate_status, goaffpro_add_affiliate_coupon.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: goaffpro_search_affiliates, goaffpro_set_affiliate_status · Private data: goaffpro_list_affiliates · Public sink: goaffpro_search_affiliates, goaffpro_set_affiliate_status, goaffpro_add_affiliate_coupon

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
